vv40:1.1: surattavatthanivāsane mahiddhike candanaruciragatte kā tvaṃ subhe devate vandase mamaṃ. || ||
vv40:2.1: Pallaṅko ca te mahaggho nānāratanacittito ruciro yattha tvaṃ nisinnā virocasi devarājā-r-iva Nandane vane. || ||
vv40:3.1: Kiṃ tvaṃ pure sucaritam ācarī bhadde kissa kammassa vipākaṃ anubhosi devalokasmiṃ devate pucchitācikkha kissa kammass' idaṃ phalan ti. || ||
vv40:4.1: Piṇḍāya te carantassa mālaṃ phāṇitañ ca adadaṃ bhante tassa kammass' idaṃ vipākaṃ anubhomi devalokasmiṃ. || ||
vv40:5.1: Hoti ca me anutāpo aparaddhaṃ dukkatañ ca me bhante sāhaṃ dhammaṃ nāssosiṃ sudesitaṃ dhammarājena. || ||
vv40:6.1: Taṃ taṃ vadāmi bhaddante yassa me anukampiyo koci dhammesu taṃ samādapetha sudesitaṃ dhammarājena. || ||
vv40:7.1: Yesaṃ atthi saddhā buddhe dhamme ca saṅgharatane ca te maṃ ativirocanti āyunā yasasā siriyā, || ||
vv40:8.1: Patāpena vaṇṇena uttaritarā aññe mahiddhikatarā mayā devā ti. || ||
